{{Quote|You're speaking to a Special Forces commander, meat. Show some respect.|Ghulil speaks to the leader of the Imperial forces|<ref name="Black Talon" />}}
'''Ghulil''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and war veteran who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Towards the end of the Cold War, Ghulil was aboard the Republic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' when it was transporting the Imperial defector known as "[[The General]]" and helped to defend it when it was [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|attacked]] by the Imperial [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]''. When Imperial forces boarded the ''Brentaal Star'' to retrieve The General, Ghulil confronted their leader and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Black Talon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ghulil first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he is the second boss of the Imperial Flashpoint "The Black Talon." According to the game's text files, the Black Talon Flashpoint originally included a conversation cutscene with Ghulil prior to the fight with him; Ghulil would have identified himself as "Special Forces Commander Ghulil&mdash;honored hero of the Dac Military Academy."
